ui_bugs.issue: Owner check reads window.localStorage.getItem('tg_user_id') but no code path ever SETS 'tg_user_id' (auth stores token under 'tg_token' and user via useAuth() context). Consequence: the character-forge-power-bundles card with forge-power-pack-link and forge-power-bundle-link buttons NEVER renders, even for the character's owner. Review-spec feature (6b) is effectively dead code.

critical_code_review_comments: CharacterSheet.jsx:534 — dead ownership check. Fix: replace `ch.owner_id === window.localStorage?.getItem?.('tg_user_id')` with the useAuth() hook (`const { user } = useAuth(); … user?.id === ch.owner_id`). Same file already imports/uses context elsewhere.

CharacterSheet.jsx is now 1411 lines (up from 1348 in V6.6) — definitely past the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting the power-packs / power-bundles / forge sections into a PowerBundlesSection.jsx sub-component.

EncounterDesigner.jsx systemId prop defaults to 'anime-5e' (line 15) and SessionView mounts it with systemId={campaign?.system_id} (line 539). Good. BESM/non-BESM conditional rendering on lines 66-74/88-105/143-176 is clean.

BESM encounter-budget endpoint uses integer floor for max_count (line 352). For a demigod-tier foe (ratio 2.5) on a party of 4 at 'equal' difficulty, `encounter_budget // (pc_cp*2.5)` often yields 0 — so the 'demigod' slot is silently omitted from the response (the `if n >= 1` guard on line 353). Not a bug per se, but review spec expected all 4 tiers. Verified: on the seeded BESM campaign at party_size=4 + hard, only underling/equal/boss show up. Consider returning slots with max_count=0 so the UI can render 'not affordable' rows.
generate-sheet endpoint does NOT validate threat_tier — any value falls through to the default 'equal' mapping silently. Consider explicit 400 on bad input.

generate-sheet for besm-4e hardcodes 2 attributes (Combat Mastery + Tough) and 1 skill regardless of codex node kind. A 'creature' vs 'npc' node should probably yield different attribute rosters — current behaviour is system-agnostic within BESM.

rca of the issue: CharacterSheet.jsx:534 bug — V6.7 added a new ownership-gated 'Power Forge' card. The author wrote `ch.owner_id === window.localStorage?.getItem?.('tg_user_id')` but `tg_user_id` is never set anywhere in the codebase (grep -rn 'tg_user_id' /app/frontend/src/ returns only line 534 itself). The rest of the app uses `useAuth()` from /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js which provides a `user` object via React context, and the auth token lives under localStorage key `tg_token`. Fix: `import { useAuth } from '../lib/api';` then `const { user } = useAuth();` and change the gate to `user?.id === ch.owner_id`. Alternatively, if the author wanted a pure-localStorage path, the auth flow would need to additionally `localStorage.setItem('tg_user_id', data.user.id)` in login/register handlers in lib/api.js. Backend endpoints for V6.7 all behave correctly — bug is strictly frontend.
